Retain upstream command extraction, matching, regexp/magic result, flags and CommandObject. Support native SlashCommand without fabricated Message; preserve slash args. Use cached native get_me identity for literal mentions. Exclude Telegram BotCommand, caption/deep-link/CommandStart semantics.

Retain typed CallbackData pack/unpack/filter and nullable/scalar encoding. Bind native CallbackQuery and standard typing.Self. Replace Telegram 64-byte cap with explicit 4096-byte SDK budget and validate prefix/separator; packed data is signed context, never a Blocks action_id or selected_option.

Retain reusable chunked buffered/filesystem upload sources. Remove Telegram Bot/session and URL download coupling; use a fresh owned local handle per read, stdlib asyncio.to_thread instead of aiofiles, explicit MIME metadata, and bounded filename/chunk validation for Mattermost multipart uploads.
Telegram deep-link encoding and token URL semantics are not Mattermost commands; removed with CommandStart, no runtime stub.
